description: This file defines various Hive User Defined Functions (UDFs), UDTFs, and UDAFs for integration with Spark SQL, including classes for simple UDFs, generic UDFs, UDTFs, and UDAFs, along with their evaluation, serialization, and merging logic.

classes.name: HiveSimpleUDF
classes.description: Represents a simple Hive UDF within Spark, handling evaluation, code generation, and data type conversions.

classes.name: HiveGenericUDF
classes.description: Represents a generic Hive UDF with evaluation and code generation capabilities.

classes.name: HiveGenericUDTF
classes.description: Wraps a Hive UDTF as a Spark Generator, managing input/output inspectors, processing, and result collection.

classes.name: HiveUDAFFunction
classes.description: Implements a Hive UDAF (User Defined Aggregate Function) with state management, serialization, merging, and evaluation logic.

classes.name: HiveUDAFBuffer
classes.description: Data structure holding an aggregation buffer and merge capability flag for Hive UDAFs.

methods.name: withNewMutableAggBufferOffset
methods.description: Creates a copy of HiveUDAFFunction with a new mutable aggregation buffer offset.

methods.name: withNewInputAggBufferOffset
methods.description: Creates a copy of HiveUDAFFunction with a new input aggregation buffer offset.

methods.name: createEvaluationBuffer
methods.description: Creates a new HiveUDAFBuffer for aggregation.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the aggregation buffer with new input data.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the aggregation buffer to produce a result.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes an aggregation buffer into bytes for shuffling.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes bytes into an aggregation buffer.
